# Birthday-Cake Loading

> Birthday-Cake Loading (npm: @shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading) is an open source TypeScript library for capability-first progressive enhancement in React and Next.js. It reads Save-Data, prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-reduced-data, device memory, CPU cores and network quality (Client Hints on the server, browser APIs on the client), assigns one of four tiers (base, lite, rich, ultra) and renders or lazy-loads heavier layers only when the device can afford them. This site is its live demo: the page starts as plain HTML and stacks layers on top for the visitor's tier.

- Install: `npm install @shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading`
- Source and full README: https://github.com/shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later (releases up to 0.3.3 were Apache-2.0). Made by shiftbloom studio: https://shiftbloom.studio

## How the tier is chosen

Save-Data or very low memory gives base. Low memory, few cores or a constrained network gives lite. High memory and many cores give ultra. Everything else is rich. Each tier maps to feature flags such as motion, richImages, audio and smoothScroll.

## Entry points

- `@shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading`: CakeProvider, CakeLayer (render by minimum tier), CakeUpgrade (lazy-load by tier, e.g. on idle), CakeWatch (swaps watched layers back to their fallbacks while frames drop or long tasks pile up), useCakeFeatures, initCakeRuntime (no-provider mode with `data-cake-tier="rich+"` attributes)
- `@shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading/server`: getServerCakeBootstrapFromHeaders and getServerFeatures for Next.js server components
- `@shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading/devtools`: CakeDevTools, an in-app panel with a session tier override

## Minimal example

```tsx
"use client";
import { CakeProvider, CakeLayer } from "@shiftbloom-studio/birthday-cake-loading";

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <CakeProvider>
      <CakeLayer minTier="rich" fallback={<img src="/hero.jpg" alt="" />}>
        <AnimatedHero />
      </CakeLayer>
    </CakeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Pages

- [Live demo](https://birthday-cake.shiftbloom.studio/): shows the tier your device got, the signals behind it and the layers it unlocked.
